title: M3-3 final directive Phase E: research eligibility registry and fail-closed assembly check
objective: Record every M3-3 DvP feature's research evidence, classification and production eligibility in one machine-readable registry extending arbit_model.feature_specs, with a fail-closed check at the model assembly boundary, so no later agent mistakes a feature's existence, historical reliability, research promise or prospective confirmation for production eligibility. No feature is activated and no production behavior or legacy constant changes. Also close AUD-01a now that unattended publication is verified with the owner-registered key.

review.summary: Inspected the existing feature registry (arbit_model.feature_specs: FEATURES with definitions, units, windows, sources and SHRINKAGE constants; legacy DvP columns opp_dvp_{QB..K}_{pg,pg_shrunk,adj,adj_shrunk,opps_pg} and opp_off_dst_allowed_*) and its consumers (team_features only; no production model assembles them). Collected each feature's evidence from the committed receipts (reliability-results A05/A07, backtest receipts, sitstart, league v2, explore-v3, simulation-v1, threshold-sensitivity-v1). Verified the owner-registered deploy key from the timer's service context (AUD-01a).

plan.summary: 1) A machine-readable registry (config/model/research-eligibility.json) with the directive's fields and initial classifications. 2) arbit_model.eligibility: load with validation (required fields, evidence kinds, classifications, no production eligibility without recorded approvals), governing() by entry id, feature_specs patterns and estimator columns, check_assembly failing closed for production and reporting for research. 3) Tests. 4) feature_specs note and an AGENTS.md rule pointing production assembly at the gate; no feature activated, no constant changed. 5) Docs and records; close AUD-01a.

implementation.summary: config/model/research-eligibility.json (10 entries); arbit_model/eligibility.py (load, governing, check_assembly, classifications, covered; RegistryError, IneligibleFeature; DVP_LIKE pattern for unregistered DvP-like names); feature_specs docstring note; AGENTS.md rule.
